title: Pro Shop Store Credit: closure-settlement qualifying threshold
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers which percentage basis applies to the sum still standing on a member's account once that account is closed, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
At closure, the sum still standing on the account is refunded at the tier's own refund percentage when that sum meets or exceeds the tier's own smallest closure-refund floor. Where that sum falls below that floor, it is instead forfeited at the tier's own forfeiture percentage, with the remainder of that sum still refunded at the tier's own refund percentage. Before this settlement can apply the refund percentage on its own, the sum still standing on the account at the moment of closure must already meet or exceed that floor; where it does not, the forfeiture-percentage branch applies instead.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)
Suppose a tier's own smallest closure-refund floor is 5.00 USD and its forfeiture percentage is 50 percent. If the sum still standing on the account at closure is 5.00 USD, that sum meets the floor and the refund-percentage branch applies to the whole of it. If instead the sum still standing on the account at closure is 3.00 USD, that sum falls below the floor, so 50 percent of the 3.00 USD is forfeited and the remaining 50 percent is still refunded at the tier's own refund percentage.
